newsitem.title: USA: General Wireless gets FCC licenses for PCS.
newsitem.headline: General Wireless gets FCC licenses for PCS.

text.p: General Wireless Inc said Monday it had received licenses from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission to provide personal communications services (PCS) in 14 market areas with an aggregate population of some 20 million.
The company said the areas the licenses cover include San Francisco, Miami, and Atlanta.
It said it had already chosen Lucent Technologies Inc to construct its turnkey CDMA wireless PCS networks in its areas.

Based in Dallas, General Wireless has strategic relationships with Hyundai Electronics America, which will serve as an alternate supplier of infrastructure equipment and a provider of handset equipment and Mitsui Comtek, which is helping it with the procurement of certain equipment and services.
